create_transform_wrapper: create a RandomizeEnvTransform instance that wraps an existing transform with optional environment randomization
apply_transform_to_tensor: apply a wrapped transform to a PyTorch tensor with optional environment count N
randomize_across_environments: randomize augmentation across multiple environments by reshaping tensors with einsum and applying per-environment transforms
optimize_single_timestep_transform: optimize transform application when timestep T equals 1 by skipping environment reshaping for speed
handle_single_image_input: handle single image inputs by detecting 3D tensors and automatically unsqueezing and squeezing dimensions
